findings.finding: The evaluation adapter binds source IDs to one capture_record_order list and binds the complete normalized observation tensors by aggregate file/tensor hashes and generic record slots. It does not require per-row activation/mask/position slice hashes for the 256-row evaluation observations. A separately regenerated observation file could preserve the declared source-ID list while permuting rows and still satisfy the adapter if all aggregate bindings were regenerated consistently.
